verdict.rationale: llamafile ships pre-built, self-contained executables that you download, mark executable, and run with no installation or compilation. Hands-on reports confirm it works first try on Linux and on stock Windows for CPU inference. Missing for 10: no evidence of OS package-manager distributions (e.g. apt/brew), and community reports say faster GPU use on Windows required installing dev tools and compiling at the time, which conflicts with the vendor's claim of shipped GPU acceleration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: We provide pre-built llamafiles for a variety of models, so you can easily run them immediately without setup.
Download a model from our example llamafiles page, make it executable, and run it.
Runs on a wide range of operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux, BSD, etc.), without installation or setup.
llamafile will work on stock Windows installs using CPU inference. No CUDA or MSVC or DLLs are required!
worked easily on desktop Linux, first try.
